assessment_scope.source_boundary: Only re-zero:priscilla-barielle@light-novel#character-model, the canonical generation V1.0 Priscilla Barielle V01-V18 source-bounded character model at basis_commit, read in full as reviewed repository analysis of the admitted Japanese main light novels; the model declares that it integrates sixty-six bounded contextual revisits of already consumed V04, V06 and V16-V18 deliveries, that a V05 window is contextual negative evidence only and that the V01-V18 label is a horizon, not an appearance in every volume. The project's current-state entrypoint was read for method, authority order, gate state and scope only. The frozen volume readings, the master and five specialist ledgers, the source lock, the reconstruction protocol, the separate Priscilla fidelity review, the V19 reading and its recorded Priscilla reconciliation, and the Japanese EPUBs are not curated evidence on this subject and nothing is borrowed from them; EX and side-story, web-novel, IF, supplement and adaptation material is excluded.
assessment_scope.temporal_boundary: The model's default is living V18 RZ-E-021 at the accepted Fourth/Wrath assignment with Liliana and the announced start of the collective operation, before any depicted arrival at the Fourth tower or result; plus its explicit historical selectors: the V04 street, carriage and court encounters (RZ-E-008), the superseded V06 early private audience (RZ-E-010), the V16 breakfast, artist refusal and post-park-point food exchange (RZ-E-018), the V17 E020 head-butt aftermath, the V17 E021 park departure, the V18 alley and shelter search before Schult is found, and the V18 meeting return through the assignment. Superseded E010, E018 post-park-point and E020 experiences are not default memories; childhood, natal identity, complete marriage history and the intervening year are not supplied. No state after V18 is established and no in-world dates are fixed.
assessment_scope.assessment_method: characters/RECONSTRUCTION_CAPABILITY_SPEC.md and governance/policies/CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MAINTENANCE.md at basis_commit; evidence-located calibration with countercases, explicit gaps and no model-readiness inheritance.

dimensions.note: Section 1 states a governing argument (value recognized on her own terms, with the response she thinks that value warrants as a separate fact) and keeps both the harm set (humiliation of Subaru, origin insults to Emilia, the Astrea breakfast sabotage, blows to Al, unconsented cuts) and the care set (the accepted artist refusal and apology, the Schult search, reliance on Liliana) active; section 4 separates her self-model (world as garden, merciful self-description) from enacted consequence, and section 10 tests ten reductive readings with revision thresholds. Fourteen conditional rules carry contrary instances but no confidence ratings, motives are inferred from speech and conduct without focalized interior, her steadiness under the Wrath effect is left unexplained and the model disclaims a final settled psychology, so A is not supported; the rival readings, contrary-instance rules and self-model boundary exceed specialist interpretation alone, so C is not supported.

Section 2 supplies a seven-coordinate default and nine historical selectors with rollback rules (selecting E010 does not import the V18 blessing identification or coalition familiarity), and section 1 distinguishes local revisions (V16 nonrecognition against V18 recognition of the broadcast voice; acknowledged surprise at Subaru's refusal of electoral gain) from conversion. The observed record is discontinuous episodes in V04, V06 and V16-V18, the intervening year is named but not supplied, and the model states that no smooth development or settled endpoint is established, so B is not supported; the selectors and firewalls are explicit and located, so D is not supported.

Section 9 gives a recipient-conditioned register account: 妾 ruby-read わらわ as stable first person; 貴様, 凡骨 and 凡愚 as selective belittling address; 女狐 for Anastasia; 歌女 (ウタメ) for Liliana; アル against a sharper local アルデバラン that Al objects to; 許せ with her self-attributed 無粋 after Liliana's vocational explanation; borrowed modernisms; and a located short surprise at V18 p-006#B0825-0831; it also separates Al's, Anastasia's, Liliana's and Schult's idioms from hers. Few exact forms are block-located, there is no sentence-ending or lexical inventory, and the model states that a constructed English outline cannot certify exact Japanese phrasing and that unattested registers require abstention, so B is not supported; the recipient-conditioned address and the located refusal-to-apology register shift exceed a described register, so D is not supported.

Section 6 tabulates ten ordinary domains with positive evidence and explicit nontransfer: absorbed reading and her rule against criticizing an unread work, Al's report that she rises and sleeps early, the linga fruit error and update, repeated game wins and a granted irregular loss, ornate dress and slow showy transport, the dance-and-song collaboration, household roles for Al and Schult, reported territorial governance and skilled fan and mirror handling. Most domains rest on one or two scenes, the daily rhythm is an attributed report, and favorites, diet, routines and governing methods are refused, so B is not supported; the domains are located, bounded and tied to rules, so D is not supported.

Section 7 differentiates Subaru (selected V04 help and game history, superseded E010 humiliation, V16 nonrecognition, E021 interest, test and surprise), Al (real retainer agency under coercion, plea and wrist restraint, punishment and dismissal of his role), Schult (named dependent and search priority), Liliana (handshake, tolerated hug against a rejected leap, accepted refusal and apology, later pride pressure and self-staked trust), Emilia and Beatrice, the Astrea family and Felt, Anastasia and the coalition, and Rom and civilians; R05-R08 and R12 condition behavior on the relation, and probe P02 holds phase constant while changing only the recipient. The comparisons are documentary rather than controlled, Al's full history and allegiance are unprovided and the evidence is one same-analyst artifact, so A is not supported; several relations carry located multi-phase conditioning with stated exceptions, so C is not supported.

The model reaches Priscilla's inner life through her own located self-accounts (the world-as-garden explanation of accepting Liliana's vocation, the self-attributed discourtesy, the admitted unfamiliar idea at Subaru's refusal, her stated Schult priority) and through observed conduct, while section 8 and N16-N17 forbid supplying private motive as dialogue and the V17 gaze and urging keep motive and foreknowledge bounded. There is no focalized interior, her Wrath steadiness has no supported mechanism and the model treats much of her apparent certainty as performed confidence, so B is not supported; the explicit self-model and its separation from enacted consequence exceed inference from conduct alone, so D is not supported.

Interpersonal and political conflict is well covered across phases: the V04 grab and bite, public sovereignty and pleasure in the unequal duel, the V06 kick and expulsion, the V16 intervention in the Astrea gathering, headship argument, stopped killing stroke and blow to Al, the V18 invasive thigh and nape cuts, the demibeast burn, punishment of Al, pressure on Liliana's inherited pride and coalition negotiation with Anastasia's successful practical rebuke; R01, R04, R06 and R08-R10 model these with counterconditions, and section 10 rejects both pure whim and refusal of all criticism. Martial conflict is thin (one beast burn and an interrupted stroke), the sword's source, cost and operating conditions are unsupplied, no tower or Sirius result is performed and the artifact is single, so A is not supported; the conflict set is multi-recipient, multi-phase and rule-structured with exceptions, so C is not supported.

The evidence locates value-based discriminations in her own words and acts: accepting Liliana's vocational refusal and apologizing, prioritizing the irreplaceable Schult over joining Subaru or finding the self-reliant Al, staking her own life on Liliana's voice, and acknowledging surprise at Subaru's refusal to gain from her death; R05, R07, R12 and R13 rule them, and R09 keeps benefit from authorizing method. The model calls these conditional discriminations rather than a universal ethics, shows little explicit weighing of competing claims, and keeps the coercion and harm that coexist with them, so B is not supported; the discriminations are located across phases and ruled, so D is not supported.

Located play and amusement: the V04 game with repeated wins, rapid learning, declared-hand pressure and a win granted for the entertainment of an irregular hand; delight in humiliation and admitted amusement at the Astrea gathering; the self-serving tableware joke during allocation; borrowed modernisms incorporated into sovereign phrasing; and the V16 janken query. R02 lets interest earn a concession and R10 and R14 bound amusement and performance. Much of the play is cruel or status-driven, humor is not analyzed as a register of its own and instances are few, so B is not supported; the instances are located and tied to rules with contrary cases, so D is not supported.

Section 0 declares the admitted Japanese V01-V18 horizon and excludes V19 and later, EX and side stories, IF routes, web novel, manga, anime and remembered franchise biography; it counts the sixty-six contextual deliveries, 3,302 positions and five viewed illustrations, records original size, hash and CRC checks, and section 3 routes E01-E16 to frozen readings and exact block ranges while preserving the V04 p-011#B0270 left-hand wording conflict. The readings, ledgers, source lock, fidelity review and EPUBs are outside this evidence set, the project entrypoint records a V19 Priscilla reconciliation that this horizon does not include, and the series continues, so B is not supported; the boundary is exact and located, so D is not supported.

Affirmative located limitations and contradictions: her ignorance of the unpeeled linga, the irregular-hand oversight she concedes, genuine V16 nonrecognition of Subaru, explicit diagnostic questions, the disclaimer that she repaired the leg, the explicitly rejected no-empathy theory, the uncompleted foot contact in E010, the prevented Heinkel stroke, Al's dissatisfaction and the absence of any tower result, plus the preserved V04 left-hand wording conflict; sections 8, 10 and 11 (N01-N28) turn these into required abstentions. All of it lives in one same-analyst artifact whose locators were not rechecked here, so A is not supported; these are located counterinstances rather than gaps, so C is not supported.

Section 2 fixes the default and nine selectors with knowledge and memory firewalls: the park point at Liliana's second-song request divides retained V16 history (the artist apology) from the discarded later food exchange, E010 and E020 experiences are explicit overrides only, Subaru's loop memories are never hers, and historical selection must roll back later information and relationships; section 8 tabulates what she has received at each surface. The intervening year is unsupplied, no in-world dates are fixed and the artifact is single, so A is not supported; the firewalls are explicit and located, so C is not supported.

scenario_readiness.note: Section 7 gives a matched-recipient test procedure and section 12 eight bounded probes that name the rule doing the work and the remaining unknowns; section 11 lists required abstentions. Readiness is conditional because the rules carry no confidence ratings, the record is discontinuous, the Wrath steadiness and sword mechanics are unexplained and the model is tested only by a same-analyst nonblind documentary review. READY would treat the probe design as validation; NOT_READY would deny an explicit, state-bound application protocol.

CONDITIONAL would license a romance frame the model explicitly refuses; NOT_ASSESSED would ignore these located refusals. Her valued relations are covered under relationship conditioning.

known_limits.statement: The default is living V18 E021 at the accepted Fourth assignment; superseded E010 audience, E018 post-park-point food exchange and E020 head-butt warning are available only by explicit selection, she never receives Subaru's Return by Death or discarded deaths, and a historical selection must roll back later information and relationships.

The record consists of V04, V06 and V16-V18 episodes; childhood, natal identity, the intervening year and a complete marital history are not supplied, Leip Barielle is named only as her deceased husband, and Al's full history, powers and allegiance remain unprovided.

Her apparent steadiness under the local Wrath effect is a genuine contrast with no supported mechanism: Subaru's no-empathy explanation is explicitly abandoned after her Schult concern and the song moves even her, and neither a diagnosis nor an immunity blessing may be supplied.

The sword's source, cost, targeting and operating conditions are unsupplied, the Heinkel stroke is prevented rather than executed, the beast result is not a Sirius result, and no Fourth-tower arrival, victory or completed song efficacy is depicted.

V04 p-011#B0270 literally gives Al a left hand at the helmet seam against the dominant one-armed frame; the model preserves the isolated wording without correcting it or inventing a regenerated arm, which limits that gesture claim only.

The model's PASS_WITH_BOUND verdict is a same-analyst nonblind documentary review with no independent reviewer, held-out source, response benchmark or character runtime; its MONOGRAPH_READY readiness label and local fidelity state are project labels, not reconstruction grades.

The frozen V04, V06 and V16-V18 deep readings, the master and specialist ledgers, the source lock, the reconstruction protocol, the separate Priscilla fidelity review, the V19 reading with the Priscilla reconciliation the project entrypoint records, and the Japanese EPUBs are not curated evidence on this subject, so the model's block locators and viewed illustrations were not rechecked here and no independent reconstruction test is in the evidence set. Missing support is not evidence of absence.
